messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Page: elevated 5xx and gateway timeouts for /v1/generate in us-west-2. Triggered rule: global_5xx_rate > 0.8% for 1m. Pager: liam.

liam: Ack. Seeing a spike in 502/504 in the gateway logs and timeouts from text-gen pool. Link: https://console.redwood/d/alerts/usw-5xx

nora: Pulling gateway + router logs now. Initial: a cluster of 502s to upstream-alpha between 09:10-09:13 PDT. Lots of long-tail latency on requests >1.2s.

own: No infra deploys. CPU/mem on hosts look normal. Noted a big internal benchmark that kicked off at 09:05 hitting contexts ~1600 tokens. Could be correlated.

liam: Immediate mitigation plan: 1) flip 40% of new sessions off upstream-alpha to fallback pool, 2) reduce max-inflight for text-gen instances in us-west-2 from 220 -> 120, 3) mute the noisy 1m page for 20m to allow mitigation without paging storms.

priya: I'll do the routing flip and the concurrency change. Also muting the alert now.

incident-bot: (automation) Alert muted by priya for 20m.

quinn: Routing change applied. Gateway 502s to upstream-alpha dropped ~60% within 45s. Overall 5xx down to ~0.35%.

liam: Good. Customer-impact quick note: sampling shows ~5% of user-facing sessions errored during the 09:10-09:16 PDT window. CS should be notified postmortem.

nora: For the post-incident ticket I propose the following action items:
- split global 5xx alert into gateway_5xx (component=gateway, group by upstream) and backend_5xx (component=backend/model). Right now a single bucket creates confusion.
- change default aggregation for infra-level pages from 1m -> 5m to reduce noisy pages, but keep 1m for critical per-endpoint pages.
- add context_length_bucket label to request metrics so we can filter alerts/dashboards by request length.
- add per-upstream alert configs (thresholds/for) since some providers are noisy.
- implement router soft-reroute automation (configurable % and escalate windows).

priya: Agree. Also add a SLI-based escalation: page only if service_error_fraction > 1% after 3m of gateway blip. That prevents paging on provider flaps that don't affect customers.

own: Draft prom example for splitting gateway errors by upstream:```yaml
- alert: Gateway5xxByUpstream
  expr: sum(rate(api_gateway_response_codes{code=~"5..",component="gateway"}[5m])) by (upstream) / sum(rate(api_gateway_requests[5m])) by (upstream) > 0.015
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "Sustained gateway 5xx for {{ $labels.upstream }}"
```

quinn: And a short-window per-endpoint alert for critical endpoints:
```yaml
- alert: CriticalEndpoint5xx
  expr: sum(rate(api_response_total{code=~"5..",endpoint=~"/v1/generate-critical"}[1m])) / sum(rate(api_request_total{endpoint=~"/v1/generate-critical"}[1m])) > 0.01
  for: 1m
  labels:
    severity: page
```

liam: Also we need dashboards: a panel for 5xx broken down by upstream, a panel for 5xx by context_length_bucket, and an overlay with internal eval traffic so we can spot correlations. Observability can add these.

nora: I'll create a temp dashboard and link it. Also will collect provider noise history for upstream-alpha and others so we can propose per-upstream thresholds.

priya: For automation, propose router behavior: on detection of upstream-specific gateway spike above X% for Y window, soft-reroute Z% immediately; if user-facing errors > threshold after 3m escalate to full failover and page SRE. I'll draft spec.

own: We should also reduce alerting blast radius: change default notification for provider-specific gateway blips to channel-only, escalate to page only if user-facing SLOs degrade.

quinn: Customer comms: CS reported two Intercom tickets during the window. We'll include affected window and mitigation summary in postmortem.

incident-bot: Incident resolved (automated): 5xx returned to normal for 15m. Post-incident ticket created RW-INC-5133.

liam: Assigning follow-ups:
- nora: temp dashboard + provider noise history (due +4h)
- priya: PR for router soft-reroute spec + automation tests (due +2d)
- owen: PR to split alerts and adjust windows in rulebook (due EOD)
- quinn: draft customer message & coordinate with CS (due +24h)

priya: Note for runbook: add a checklist to throttle internal long-eval jobs during global high-tail events; maybe auto-shed internal evals when gateway error fraction crosses X.

liam: One more tweak: create a derived metric user_error_fraction that filters by client-visible requests only (exclude internal health checks/batches) so paging decisions are tied to customer impact.

own: Good idea. We'll add that to the metrics backlog.

liam: Handoff: I'm off in 10m. @nora please monitor RW-INC-5133 for 45m and escalate if anything reoccurs.

nora: Monitoring.

(reacts: :white_check_mark: from quinn, :eyes: from priya)
